title: Collab P0: @flash/collab Yjs binding (FlashDocument<->Y.Doc), property-tested, no networking
description: DONE (P0). @flash/collab Yjs derived-binding shipped. Package packages/collab (@flash/collab, depends @flash/core types-only + yjs; Yjs stays OUT of @flash/core). Full FlashDocument<->Y.Doc mapping: root Y.Map; scenes/layers/frames positional Y.Array; frame.displayObjects + library.items Y.Map<id,child>+__order array; displayObject scalars per-field Y.Map, shape/filters/colorEffect/warp ATOMIC plain-JSON LWW; symbol.timeline nested; asClasses Y.Map<path,Y.Text> char-level; properties per-field; classpaths/publishProfiles/flaSwfBlobs atomic arrays (blob bytes->base64, import-only); bitmap/sound/video dataUri are scalar strings (bytes out-of-band in P4).
